meta.note: Names and descriptions are the ones corroborated across PowerPyx, PushSquare and Insider Gaming (all published 18-20 Nov 2026 from the finished game). Where sources disagree, the majority reading is used and the disagreement is noted in the guide text. Rockstar has not published its own standalone trophy list, so these are the published lists' consensus, not a Rockstar press release.
sources: PowerPyx — GTA 6 (Grand Theft Auto VI) Trophy Guide & Roadmap — https://www.powerpyx.com/gta-6-grand-theft-auto-vi-trophy-guide-roadmap/
Insider Gaming — Complete GTA 6 Trophy List: How To Get All Trophies & Achievements — https://insider-gaming.com/complete-gta-6-trophy-list-how-to-get-all-trophies-achievements/

trophies.name: Vice Got a Price!
trophies.guide: The Platinum pops automatically the moment the other 54 trophies are all earned. There is no separate task: work through the roadmap in this guide, finish the 100% completion checklist for A Long Road, then clean up any stray trophies. Everything is offline and single-player, so no online mode or DLC is ever needed.

trophies.name: A Long Road
trophies.guide: The hardest trophy in the set and the backbone of the whole platinum. After the final mission, open Progress, then Stats, then 100% Completion to see the checklist. It is far more forgiving than it sounds: PowerPyx puts it near 60% true completion, with most side quests not required and many collectibles only partly required. Scan 200 of 277 base vehicle models and study 100 of 255 animals with binoculars as you play, do optional missions whenever they appear, and finish the checklist's full requirements — all robberies, underwater discoveries, shooting ranges, drone races and Bret's quests — after the story in free roam. Nothing on the checklist is missable.

trophies.name: Cunning Stunts
trophies.guide: Complete any 250 of the 397 stunts across Leonida. The four types are stunt jumps (130), flying under bridges (202), knife flights between buildings (40) and base jumps (25). Mix and match: under-bridge flights are the quickest to rack up. Track progress under Progress, then Activities, then Stunts, and find stunt spots on the map under Exploration. The 100% checklist wants 300 stunts, so keep going past 250 if you are chasing A Long Road.

trophies.name: Master of None
trophies.description: Try each type of activity once.
trophies.guide: Try each of the nine activity types at least once: fishing, hunting, golf, shooting ranges, pool, basketball, playing a video game, winning a car race or race challenge or drone race, and performing a stunt. Check your tally under Progress, then Activities. Most of these turn up naturally during the story and while working on other trophies; the map's Activities filter (blue dumbbell icon) points you at anything you have not tried yet.

trophies.name: The Shootist
trophies.description: Earn a gold medal in all Shooting Range challenges.
trophies.guide: Earn a gold medal in all 42 shooting range challenges across the two ranges: Rodgers Ranch & Shooting Range in Port Gellhorn and Griffin Shooting Range in Balsero. Most challenges have three difficulty tiers, and some stay locked until you meet their conditions, which the map shows. Track progress under Progress, then Activities, then Shooting Ranges. This is one of the longer grinds, so spread it out and practise the weapon types you are weakest with first.

trophies.name: Top Fun
trophies.description: Win a Top Fun Drone Race at every location.
trophies.guide: Win a Top Fun drone race at all 14 locations. Some races charge an entry fee, so bring cash. Find locations on the map under Activities, then Drones, then Top Fun Drones. Learn each course's turns before pushing for speed — a clean line beats a fast crash — and remember the 100% checklist also wants the drone races done.

trophies.name: Earn Cash, Not Kudos
trophies.guide: Win 20 different races — replaying the same race does not count twice. Race locations appear as you explore Leonida and are listed under Progress, then Activities, then Racing. Most locations let you hire a car; if you bring your own, check its Rating and upgrade it at a Mod Shop first. Pick the short, simple circuits early and save the trickier ones for when your driving is warmed up.

trophies.name: Baited My Tackle
trophies.description: Beat Cal in a fishing challenge.
trophies.guide: After the Chapter 1 mission where you meet Cal, he texts you a fishing challenge: catch a parrotfish over 2 kg. Follow the purple map marker west of Key Lento, take a boat with a fishing rod, and fish the marked area until you land a big enough parrotfish. If the fish you hook are too small, keep casting — size varies per catch, so patience is the whole trick.

trophies.name: Stick Fiddler
trophies.guide: Finish all the levels of any one of the four arcade games (called Video Games in-game): Tenebrae Lux, Street Trash III, Time Jackers Rewind, or Bang For Your Buck. The first three are playable on the TV at home using the controllers, from Chapter 1 onwards. Bang For Your Buck is on arcade machines around the world. You only need to reach the end once — bonus challenges are optional — so pick the game you enjoy most.

trophies.name: Strangers & Freaks
trophies.description: Complete 8 mission strands for strangers across the state of Leonida.
trophies.guide: Complete eight qualifying Strangers & Freaks mission strands found in the open world. Not every side questline counts — Moses, Tyrone, Yasmani, Andy, Billy and Eddie are tracked separately and do not count here. Confirmed counting strands include Kirk (the Skunk Ape hunt), Kyle (McKittrick Farm), Yago (street racing) and Pilot Pete (deliveries), with more still being mapped by guide writers. All of them stay available after the story, so finish the story first and mop these up in free roam, watching the trophy tracker for your count.

trophies.name: Positive Mental Attitude
trophies.description: Meditate at every spot across Leonida.
trophies.guide: THE ONE POSSIBLY MISSABLE TROPHY — read this before you finish Chapter 1. Meditate at all 18 meditation spots across 10 locations in Leonida. A meditation only counts once the final 'zen' animation plays. Track them under Progress, then Collections, then Exploration, then Meditations, or on the map under Exploration, then Meditate Around Leonida. The catch: during Chapter 1, after the mission Down to Earth, Lucia may say in the kitchen in the morning that she is going to meditate, then walk to the balcony. Follow her, accept, and do the meditation with her. That balcony session raises your meditation counter but is not marked as a normal spot, and it becomes permanently unavailable after Chapter 1. PowerPyx's author earned the trophy after doing it, and whether it is strictly required is still unconfirmed — so do it in Chapter 1 to be safe. Every other spot can be done after the story, and you need both Jason and Lucia able to play together (unlocked after Coffee Break in Chapter 2) to finish the set.

trophies.name: Don't Touch My Deck
trophies.guide: Complete any 3 of the 18 collectible card sets found across Leonida. Track your sets under Progress, then Collections, then Collectible Cards. Cards you have collected can be sold at pawn shops and still count toward your progress, so don't worry about selling duplicates. If you are chasing A Long Road, you will need 15 full sets for the 100% checklist anyway, so this trophy falls out naturally along the way.

trophies.name: You WAiNKer!
trophies.guide: Scan 100 WAiNK locations with the WAiNK phone app (hold Up to open it, then hold R1 on a scannable object). Scannable things include landmarks (31), curiosities (35), sculptures (23) and No Flusher tags — far more than 100 in total, so any 100 will do. Check your count under Progress, then Collections, then WAiNK Locations. Make scanning a habit whenever you pass a landmark and the total climbs without any dedicated grind.

trophies.name: One Last Thing
trophies.guide: Complete any 50 of the game's 80 challenges. View them all under Progress, then Challenges. Most complete themselves while you work on other trophies — driving, shooting, exploring and robbing all feed challenges — so leave this for late in your cleanup and then pick the easiest remaining ones. The 100% checklist wants 70 of 80, so this trophy is a milestone on the way there, not a separate grind.

trophies.name: Hot Together
trophies.description: Lose a 4 star Wanted Level with your partner and escape the heat.
trophies.guide: Available once Jason and Lucia can free-roam together (after Coffee Break in Chapter 2). Call your partner (hold Right, then Triangle), build a 4-star wanted level by causing mayhem, then escape until you leave the red heat zone entirely — not just the flashing search area. A fast sports bike helps you cut through traffic, and the train tunnel north of Ambrosia in Kelly County is a reliable escape route because police and helicopters struggle to follow you there. This also tends to unlock by itself during the large bank vault robberies, which always trigger 4-star heat.

trophies.name: Retail Therapy
trophies.description: Rob 3 shops back-to-back with your partner without losing your Wanted Level.
trophies.guide: With your partner alongside you, rob three shops in a row while keeping your wanted level active the whole time — if the heat drops between shops, the chain breaks. Bring an armoured vest, sticky bombs and healing items (Zombix or Adrenaline) from an Ammu-Nation. A good spot is the three jewellery stores in north Vice City, available after Yasmani's jewellery jobs in Chapter 3: rob a couple of items in each, break the safe in the back room with sticky bombs, and keep moving. The trophy pops about half a minute after you leave the third shop, so don't panic if it is delayed — and if it doesn't pop, hit a fourth shop and keep the chain going.

trophies.name: Whip It Good
trophies.guide: Discover 100 different vehicles. You discover a vehicle by getting inside it or by scanning it with the WAiNK app (hold Up, look at the vehicle, hold R1). The fastest method is to stand on a busy road and scan everything that drives past — scanning counts, you don't need to drive them. There are 557 vehicles at launch, so variety is everywhere. Check your totals under Progress, then Vehicles. The 100% checklist wants 200 base models scanned, so this is another trophy that arrives on the way to A Long Road.

trophies.name: Gunslinger
trophies.description: Take down 5 enemies in a single use of Combat Focus.
trophies.guide: Defeat 5 enemies during one use of Combat Focus (aim a firearm, then press L3 + R3 to slow time and highlight weak points). It only lasts a few seconds, so set it up first: boost your focus by eating, drinking, or washing up at home, and use Adrenaline to stretch the slow-time window. Wear body armour, take a full-auto rifle like the Duke 556, and line up five enemies — gang members at an illegal operation work well — before you trigger it. It does not seem to count against soldiers, police or civilians. Focus has four levels that rise as you play shooting ranges, golf, pool, fish and land headshots, so this gets easier late in the game and may pop naturally.

trophies.name: Sneakthief
trophies.description: Rob a jewelry store without being detected.
trophies.guide: First finish Yasmani's jewellery jobs in Chapter 3. That unlocks the Snap Gun for silently picking alarmed doors, and marks jewellery store robberies (green icons) on the map in unfogged areas. Enter through the back door and choose the Snap Gun prompt instead of kicking the door, which would trip the alarm. Inside the back room, find the note with the safe code, loot the safe, destroy the security footage and disable the alarm. Slip out without being spotted and the trophy unlocks shortly after you leave. Richardson Jewelry & Diamonds in Vice City is a good first target.

trophies.name: Maximum Withdrawal
trophies.guide: Rob any 5 of the 8 large bank vaults and escape. Start by finishing the Chapter 4 optional mission That's Where The Money Is… (wait at the cafe), which introduces vault robberies: tail a security van to a bank, slip in while the vault is open, and bring your partner — you can't carry all the cash alone, so hand off a bag (hold Right). After that, pay Yasmani for security-van tips ($10,000) to mark more vans; robbing a vault instantly gives a 4-star wanted level, so escape on a fast motorcycle and switch vehicles to break recognition. Each vault pays up to $205,000, making this the best money-maker in the endgame. The 100% checklist wants all 8 vaults, so you will earn this automatically on the road to A Long Road.

trophies.name: A Classic Blitz Play
trophies.description: Rob an Armored Truck and escape.
trophies.guide: Rob an armoured truck and escape the red heat radius. The easiest route is the same Chapter 4 mission that unlocks bank vaults — tailing the truck to a bank and raiding the vault counts as robbing the truck. For an earlier method, find an armoured truck driving near a bank in Vice City, block its path, plant a sticky bomb on its back door and blow it open (sticky bombs are in the back of Yasmani's shop after his jobs), then escape the heat. You will earn this automatically while doing Maximum Withdrawal.

trophies.name: The Goodtime State
trophies.guide: Fully unfog the whole map of Leonida. The fastest way is by plane: fly over every blacked-out patch until the map is fully revealed. Work region by region so you don't miss a corner, and use the map's fog as your checklist — any dark area still needs a flyover. Do it late in the game when you have a fast plane and the whole map is open to you.

trophies.name: Pest Control
trophies.description: Rob an Illegal Operation belonging to each gang.
trophies.guide: Rob at least one illegal operation belonging to each of the 9 gangs. There are 39 illegal operations in total, marked with yellow icons when you go near them (many are also marked automatically through story progress). Track each gang's count under Progress, then Gangs. The 100% checklist wants all 39 operations, so this trophy arrives automatically while you clear them — just make sure you spread your robberies across all nine gangs rather than farming one gang's spots.

trophies.name: Dime on the Dollar
trophies.description: Earn $250,000 laundering Marked Bills through your contacts.
trophies.guide: Launder a total of $250,000 in marked bills through your contacts. First finish the Chapter 3 mission Credit Check (meet Raul's crew), which unlocks the Dye Pack Jammer. Then rob banks and Payday Loans stores, take the marked bills to a fence — Yasmani in Vice City pays the most — and the total accumulates across all your robberies, so you never need $250,000 in one trip. Bank vaults alone can pay up to $205,000 each, so this builds fast once vaults are open.

trophies.name: Treat Yo Self
trophies.guide: Spend a total of $100,000 across all shops — every dollar counts cumulatively, so normal play covers much of it. The fastest way to close the gap is on the expensive stuff: guns, car mods and tattoos. Find shops on the map under Style. If you are short near the end, buy a pricey weapon or a full round of car upgrades and the trophy pops as soon as your lifetime spending crosses $100,000.

trophies.name: Little Boxes
trophies.guide: Buy all 8 purchasable garages, costing $160,000 in total, through the Vice City Real Estate phone app (unlocked after the Chapter 2 mission Daily Driver). The garages are Mitchel Auto Center ($4,000), 7th Avenue Garage ($12,000), Vela Rota Drive Garage ($24,000), Persistence Road Garage ($7,600), Wyatt Motors ($21,600), Bonita Court Garage ($34,000), Atlantic Court Garage ($40,000) and Store n' Bolt ($16,800). Each adds vehicle storage, which you also need for On the Spot. Fund it with robbery money — bank vaults pay best — and buy them as soon as you can afford each one.

trophies.name: On the Spot
trophies.description: Register 10 vehicles to the Scooter Bros app.
trophies.guide: Register 10 vehicles in the Scooter Bros app, which is installed after the Chapter 2 mission where you take a vehicle to Moses. Scooter Bros delivers your registered, repaired vehicles to you for a small fee. To register a car, drive it to Moses in Port Gellhorn, choose Respray then Register; later, in Chapter 3, you can also register cars with standard trackers at any Pay 'n' Spray. You need enough garage parking spots first (see Little Boxes), and registration costs money, so use cheap low-end cars and bikes to keep the bill down.

trophies.name: Just Like Paradise
trophies.guide: Story trophy, cannot be missed. It pops when you finish the opening mission, Gone Fishing, Jason's first mission in Chapter 1. Just play the story and it unlocks on its own.

trophies.name: Paradise Lost
trophies.guide: Story trophy, cannot be missed. It pops when you finish Chapter 1, at the start of the first mission of Chapter 2. Before you leave Chapter 1, do the possibly-missable balcony meditation for Positive Mental Attitude — see that trophy's guide.

trophies.name: T**s Ass Drug Money
trophies.guide: Story trophy, cannot be missed. It pops when you finish Chapter 2, at the start of the first mission of Chapter 3. Note: every published list prints this name censored as shown here.

trophies.name: Vice City, Baby!
trophies.guide: Story trophy, cannot be missed. It pops when you finish Chapter 3, after the first two missions of Chapter 4. By now you should have Yasmani's jewellery jobs done and the Key Cloner unlocked — both feed several other trophies.

trophies.name: Top Of The World, Ma
trophies.guide: Story trophy, cannot be missed. It pops when you finish Chapter 4, after the final mission of the chapter. From here the game opens up into the endgame cleanup, and the 100% checklist becomes visible after the final mission.

trophies.name: You Gotta Know When to Get Off
trophies.guide: Story trophy, cannot be missed. It pops when you finish the final mission of the game. One published list describes this as completing Chapter 5; the majority of sources describe it as the final mission, which is the wording used here. After it pops, free roam continues and the 100% completion checklist unlocks — the real platinum grind starts now.

trophies.name: Trust
trophies.guide: Story trophy, cannot be missed. It pops during the Chapter 2 mission Breakfast Run. Just play through the mission and it unlocks.

trophies.name: Break the Bank
trophies.guide: Story trophy, cannot be missed. It pops during the Chapter 3 mission The Cartel Heist. Play the mission to completion and it unlocks.

trophies.name: Family Matters
trophies.guide: Story trophy, cannot be missed. It pops during the Chapter 4 mission Child's Play. Play the mission to completion and it unlocks.

trophies.name: DWNFALL
trophies.guide: Story trophy, cannot be missed. It pops during the Chapter 4 mission Headliners. Play the mission to completion and it unlocks.

trophies.name: Hi-Jacked
trophies.guide: Story trophy, cannot be missed. It pops during the Chapter 4 mission VCIA Takedown, set at Vice City International Airport. Play the mission to completion and it unlocks.

trophies.name: Snow Storm
trophies.guide: Story trophy, cannot be missed. It pops during the Chapter 5 mission Operation Savage Glory. Play the mission to completion and it unlocks.

trophies.name: Road to Rehabilitation
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Andy.
trophies.guide: Finish Andy's questline, which is exclusive to Lucia and starts automatically in Chapter 3 when Andy calls and texts her home address in Belville. Complete all five quests — the Cellerichain chain (parts 1-3), Pay the Cellerica Fee, Peach!, Read the Label and finally Puff Puff Pass at the warehouse — and the trophy pops after the last one. The whole strand stays available after the story.

trophies.name: This Was No Boat Accident
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Kenton.
trophies.guide: Finish Kenton's treasure-diving questline. It starts in Chapter 1 after the mission Island Dreams: Kenton calls, then marks himself with a green KR icon in Key Lento. He marks shipwreck treasure sites on your map — dive down, use the metal detector to dig the treasure from the ocean floor, and bring it back. Clear all 7 shipwrecks across his sets of quests; he calls you back for more after each set. Track progress under Progress, then Characters, then Kenton Rees. He goes quiet for a stretch in Chapter 1 but returns in Chapters 2-3 (playing as Jason, calling Brian can hurry his text along), and everything stays available after the story.

trophies.name: The Lone Rider
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Billy.
trophies.guide: Finish Billy's questline, marked automatically after the Chapter 2 mission Coffee Break at the Thrillbilly Mudclub in Kelly County. Complete all five jobs — Thrillbillies, Twist Wrist Smash Grab, Mall Rats, The Impaler (steal the Impaler) and finally Hometown Heroes — and the trophy pops after the last one. The strand stays available after the story.

trophies.name: Supply & Demand
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Randy.
trophies.guide: Finish Randy's Wish List. It opens after the Chapter 3 mission Clonin' Keys, Makin' GS, where you steal the Zorrusso for Randy and unlock the Key Cloner. He then wants 16 high-end sports cars delivered to his garage (green RK icon, west Vice City). Scan cars with WAiNK to check them against the list, steal them anywhere — he also marks some in fixed spots, and new marks appear as you deliver — and bring them back in good condition for better pay. His cars turn up often around Vice Beach and Ocean Beach, parked outside hotels or driving around. Deliver the full list and the trophy pops.

trophies.name: Spin On This!
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Tyrone.
trophies.guide: Finish Tyrone's questline, available only as Jason from Chapter 3 after the mission Here, Kitty Kitty. Purple markers point you at Kitty Litter synthetic labs around Vice City — go to the labs and destroy them in the Take Out Kitty Litter quest. Once you have destroyed enough labs, Tyrone gives you the second quest, Spin On This, to shut the labs down for good; completing it pops the trophy. Everything stays available after the story.

trophies.name: Fair Game
trophies.description: Hunt a unique animal for Bret.
trophies.guide: Hunt a unique animal for Bret Vogel. His questline is exclusive to Jason and starts after Coffee Break in Chapter 2, when Bret texts you to meet him in Lummox County for Veteran Hunted. He then marks hunting spots on the map and requests specific animals — bring them to him. He gives you the unique hunting rifle Killtelligence SM-69 on the first quest (retrieve it from any Ammu-Nation weapon locker); one clean shot leaves animals in pristine condition and pays more, though it isn't required. His hunts feed the 15 Target Decks, which the 100% checklist wants in full, so keep hunting past this trophy.

trophies.name: Catch Me If You Can
trophies.description: Make an unscheduled departure at VCIA.
trophies.guide: Steal a large passenger plane docked at a departure terminal at Vice City International Airport — the planes parked out on the airfield don't count; it must be one connected to a passenger boarding bridge. The easiest is the plane at terminals E3/E4: drive through a fence around the airfield, head to the plane, and use the stairs by the boarding bridge to get inside. Go upstairs into the cockpit, reverse the plane to the runway, take off, and fly at least 1 km away from the airport — the trophy pops a little late, once you are clear. You can also walk in through the terminal on foot, but the airfield route is faster.

trophies.name: Challenging Tank
trophies.guide: Steal a military Rhino tank. They are parked in the south of Mile Zero Air Station, the island at the south-west edge of the map in Mariana County. Drive through the gate — or use the stunt jump by the south-east entrance — climb into a tank and fire at enemies until the trophy pops. Expect heavy resistance from the base, so go in with full armour and health and be ready to drive out fast.

trophies.name: In The Beginning…
trophies.description: Enjoy a cocktail with a view on Ocean Beach.
trophies.guide: Go to the Ocean View Rooftop Bar on Ocean Beach, buy an Apple Martini, and drink it while standing next to the bar. The trophy pops once you have enjoyed the drink with the view. It costs almost nothing and takes a minute — a good palate cleanser between grinds.

trophies.name: Capital Offense
trophies.description: Smash your way out of a vehicle showroom in classic style.
trophies.guide: Steal the blue Banshee from the vehicle showroom in south Vice City and drive it straight out through the showroom window. You can only do this after unlocking the Key Cloner in the Chapter 3 mission Clonin' Keys, Makin' GS — hack into the car, then drive forward through the glass. The trophy pops a moment later, once you are out on the street. It has to be that specific blue Banshee, not just any showroom car; it's a nod to the Banshee from GTA III.

trophies.name: Let's Go Bowling
trophies.description: Follow-through at the Kolt & Associates' bowling alley.
trophies.guide: Steal all three key valuables at Kingpin Bowling in Port Gellhorn, one of the gang operations. It is marked automatically during the Chapter 2 optional mission Hit Kingpin Bowling. Bring sticky bombs from an Ammu-Nation first: the three items are the luxury watch in the south-east office, the unique Gutterball Moreland 850 shotgun on the table in the north-east corner, and the safe in the north-east hallway, which you blow open with sticky bombs. The trophy pops after you escape the police, not when you grab the third item — and you don't need to do all three in one visit: if you miss one, wait for the robbery icon to respawn and come back for the rest.

trophies.name: Personal Best
trophies.guide: Reach maximum strength with both Jason and Lucia at the same time. This is only possible after Coffee Break in Chapter 2, when you can switch between the two characters. Raise strength by working out — buy a fitness club membership and filter for gyms on the map under Activities. Always bring your partner along (hold Right, then Triangle to call them): while one character actively trains, the other completes their training automatically, so you make double progress. Check each character's strength under Touchpad, then Jason & Lucia, then Strength (heart icon).

trophies.name: Actions Speak Louder
trophies.guide: Perform 500 actions that affect your Criminal Profile. Turn on Criminal Profile notifications (Settings, then UI, then HUD Notifications, then Criminal Profile) and a small demon face appears on the right of the screen whenever an action counts. Stealthy finishes and clean escapes push you toward Professional; wounding without killing pushes Hardened; killing pushes Violent; mass killing pushes Psycho; and sustained excessive violence can lock you into Irredeemable permanently, which makes police far more aggressive — avoid that one. You will rack up most of the 500 naturally through robberies and fights on the road to the platinum; if you are short at the end, any profile-affecting action counts, so keep playing normally rather than farming.

trophies.name: Bad Luck, I Guess
trophies.guide: STILL UNCONFIRMED at the time of research (20 Nov 2026): no published guide has yet verified the exact trigger. PowerPyx reports it is believed to be related to the Payday Loans store from the prologue — possibly robbing it again later in a specific way — and the store is in Little Cuba, Vice City. Try returning to that Payday Loans store later in the game and robbing it a second time. Treat this as a lead, not a certainty: check the in-game trophy tracker and updated guides before spending long on it, and don't let it block the rest of your platinum run.

trophies.name: The Truth Is Out There
trophies.guide: Complete the UFO easter egg. Go alone, at night after 2 AM, to the road north-west of the Starlet Motel in Kelly County. Sometimes a blinking car is parked at the roadside — if it isn't there, drive away and come back until it spawns. Follow the path from the car into the woods and you will see the UFO (a bright blue light in the sky). Approach it and it drops a woman it abducted; talk to her, offer to help, and walk her back to her car at the roadside to unlock the trophy. The spawn is slightly random, so be patient and retry on different nights.

trophies.name: Ten Pin
trophies.description: Bowl 'em over with a melee drive-by.
trophies.guide: Ride any motorbike and kick 10 pedestrians with a melee attack (Square) within 60 seconds. Do it somewhere crowded, like Vice City or Ocean Beach, where pedestrians are packed together. Keep your speed low enough to stay among the crowd and keep kicking — the count resets if the minute runs out, so chain your kicks without stopping.
